# Track & Trace ontology tutorial part 4: Use the ontology agent

In this tutorial step, use the ontology agent to ask questions in natural language and get answers grounded in
the ontology's definitions and bindings. It's also the first check that the ontology answers the demo questions
correctly, before you build the demo agents in part 5.

## Get started with ontology agent

The ontology agent (preview) is an AI-powered Copilot that helps you build and operate ontologies over the data
in your Fabric workspace, through a chat interface and natural language. To open it, select **Ontology agent**
from the top ribbon in the home canvas. The agent opens in a pane on the right side of the screen, in **Plan**
mode by default. In Plan mode, the agent can query and explore the ontology, but it doesn't make any changes.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Write dates explicitly. The data is dated around 25 November 2026, and words like "yesterday" are resolved
> against the real current date.

## Ask questions in natural language

Enter the following question in the ontology agent text box and send it:

> Which shipping cases produced on line PL-02-L3 on 24 November 2026 have an aggregation mismatch?

The agent reasons for a short time and then answers from your ontology. Expect 120 shipping cases,
created between 06:42 and 18:36 UTC, all from production order `PO-20261124-PL02L3` (Nova Gold KS 20 for
Market Gamma). 86 cases miss one bundle and 34 miss two.

Explore the ontology further with the following questions, one per demo scene. The expected answers come from
the generated data.

| Scene | Question | Expected answer |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | How many packs were commissioned per factory on 24 November 2026, how many shipping cases had an aggregation mismatch, and which authority submissions were rejected? | 43,100 packs in total (see the table below). 120 mismatched cases, all on PL-02-L3. SUB-000163 and SUB-000167 were rejected by TA-GAMMA. |
| 2 | Why did production line PL-02-L3 have an aggregation mismatch on 24 November 2026? What do the maintenance log and the scanner telemetry show? | Scanner fault (camera 2) logged at 06:20, case aggregation station switched to bypass at 06:38, repaired at 18:40 UTC. The first mismatched case followed the fault by 22 minutes. The case scanner's read rate was 91.9% on average while in bypass. |
| 2 | What was the aggregation error rate per production line on 24 November 2026? | PL-02-L3: 75% (120 of 160 cases). All other lines: 0%. This uses the *Aggregation Error Rate %* metric from the semantic model. |
| 3 | Which shipments to Market Beta are delayed, and how many pallets, shipping cases and packs do they carry? | `SHP-20261123-PL01-BETD1` to WH-BET-D1, 26 hours late, estimated arrival 25 Nov 14:00 UTC: 12 pallets, 232 cases, 11,600 packs. |
| 4 | Provide the full trace of pack PK-PL-01-6U4NNZG5, including the carrier and the authority submissions. | Commissioned 2026-11-20 06:54 UTC on PL-01-L1 under `PO-20261120-PL01L1` → bundle `BU-PL-01-JTMDKKKA` → case `CS-PL-01-7RSZRXNH` → pallet `PAL-PL-01-2LNFLRR2` → shipment `SHP-20261120-PL01-BETD2-E` (Northgate Haulage, dispatched 2026-11-20 21:49 UTC, arrived 2026-11-21 15:31 UTC) → WH-BET-D2 Beta South Distributor. Submissions SUB-000149 (dispatch, ACCEPTED), SUB-000155 (arrival, ACCEPTED). |
| 5 | Which warehouses in Market Beta have less than 3 days of cover for SKU-03, and which warehouse in the same market could transfer stock? | WH-BET-D1: 76 cases, 36 cases a day, 2.1 days; 131 cases are in transit on the delayed truck. WH-BET-D2: 276 cases, 11.5 days; about 108 cases can move while it keeps 7 days. |
| 6 | Which packs were scanned by consumers in two different countries within 24 hours? | `PK-PL-01-DQUGV4TG`: XB (Beta City) at 24 Nov 08:46 UTC, then XZ (Port Zephyr) at 24 Nov 22:23 UTC, 8,940 km away. |

## Answer the scenario question

Use the agent to answer the major question of the Track & Trace scenario:

> Which shipments dispatched on 24 November 2026 contain shipping cases with an aggregation mismatch, which
> authority submissions were rejected because of them, and what do the maintenance log and the scanner
> telemetry of the producing line show for the same time?

The agent considers your ontology and queries your data sources. Expect:

- `SHP-20261124-PL02-GAMH1`, dispatched 24 Nov 13:51 UTC, now DELIVERED: 44 of its 100 cases have
  a mismatch. Submission **SUB-000163** was rejected with `MISSING_AGGREGATION_DATA`.
- `SHP-20261124-PL02-GAMH1-E`, dispatched 24 Nov 21:49 UTC, now IN_TRANSIT: 76 of 100 cases.
  Submission **SUB-000167** was rejected for the same reason.
- Both rejections are past Market Gamma's 4-hour SLA.
- Maintenance log of PL-02-L3: `SCANNER_FAULT` at 06:20, `OPERATING_MODE_CHANGE` to bypass at
  06:38, `REPAIR` at 18:40 UTC.
- Scanner telemetry: the case aggregation station was `DEGRADED` and in `BYPASS` from 06:38 to 18:40,
  with read rates down to 86.5%, below the 98% in the *Scanner degradation* rule.

If an answer is incomplete, check the relationship bindings from part 1 and the rules from part 2, then ask again.
Rephrasing with the business terms from the metadata (for example "aggregation mismatch" or "bypass mode") also
helps.

## Next steps

In this step, you used natural language to answer the scenario's questions with the ontology agent. Next, build
the agents that bring these answers into Copilot: [Build the demo agents](tutorial-5-build-demo-agents.md).
